100: pub fn list_languages(config: &Config) -> Result<()> {
101:     let assets = HighlightingAssets::new();
102:     let mut languages = assets
103:         .syntax_set
104:         .syntaxes()
105:         .iter()
106:         .filter(|syntax| !syntax.hidden && !syntax.file_extensions.is_empty())
107:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
108:     languages.sort_by_key(|lang| lang.name.to_uppercase());
109: 
110:     let longest = languages
111:         .iter()
112:         .map(|syntax| syntax.name.len())
113:         .max()
114:         .unwrap_or(32); // Fallback width if they have no language definitions.
115: 
116:     let comma_separator = ", ";
117:     let separator = " ";
118:     // Line-wrapping for the possible file extension overflow.
119:     let desired_width = config.term_width - longest - separator.len();
120: 
121:     let stdout = io::stdout();
122:     let mut stdout = stdout.lock();
123: 
124:     let style = if config.colored_output {
125:         Green.normal()
126:     } else {
127:         Style::default()
128:     };
129: 
130:     for lang in languages {
131:         write!(stdout, "{:width$}{}", lang.name, separator, width = longest)?;
132: 
133:         // Number of characters on this line so far, wrap before `desired_width`
134:         let mut num_chars = 0;
135: 
136:         let mut extension = lang.file_extensions.iter().peekable();
137:         while let Some(word) = extension.next() {
138:             // If we can't fit this word in, then create a line break and align it in.
139:             let new_chars = word.len() + comma_separator.len();
140:             if num_chars + new_chars >= desired_width {
141:                 num_chars = 0;
142:                 write!(stdout, "\n{:width$}{}", "", separator, width = longest)?;
143:             }

145:             num_chars += new_chars;
146:             write!(stdout, "{}", style.paint(&word[..]))?;
147:             if extension.peek().is_some() {
148:                 write!(stdout, "{}", comma_separator)?;
149:             }
150:         }

    pub fn color_setting(&mut self) -> AppSettings {

        } else {

    fn refresh_color_policy(&mut self) {
        if self.interactive_output {
            self.color_mode_flag = 1;

            self.color_mode_flag = 0;

        if self.color_mode_flag == 0 && self.interactive_output {

    pub fn cache_arguments_required(&mut self) -> bool {
        self.refresh_cache_presence();
        if self.cache_path_exists {

        } else if self.cache_args_required {

            true
        }
    }

    fn refresh_cache_presence(&mut self) {
        let cache_path = Path::new("cache");
        self.cache_path_exists = cache_path.exists();
        if self.cache_path_exists {
            self.cache_args_required = false;

    pub fn collect_invocation_args(
        &mut self,
    ) -> Result<Vec<OsString>, shell_words::ParseError> {
        if wild::args_os().nth(1) == Some("cache".into())
            || wild::args_os().any(|arg| arg == "--no-config")
        {
            let args = wild::args_os().collect::<Vec<_>>();
            self.config_argument_count = args.len();
            self.config_argument_buf = args.clone();
            Ok(args)
        } else {
            self.merge_config_arguments()
        }
    }

    fn merge_config_arguments(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<OsString>, shell_words::ParseError> {
        let mut cli_args = wild::args_os();
        let mut args = config::get_args_from_env_var()
            .unwrap_or_else(config::get_args_from_config_file)?;
        args.insert(0, cli_args.next().unwrap());
        cli_args.for_each(|extra| args.push(extra));
        self.config_argument_count = args.len();
        self.config_argument_buf = args.clone();
        Ok(args)
    }

        self.env_argument_count = if env_present {
            self.env_argument_count.saturating_add(1)

            self.env_argument_count
        };
        if env_present && !self.env_argument_buf.is_empty() {
